title: Turkish-Style Menemen Tacos
description: A twist on traditional menemen, this recipe combines the spicy flavors of Turkish cuisine with the crunch of Mexican tacos. Serve with warm tortillas and enjoy!
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add a splash of oil and cook the diced potatoes until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced menemen, quintessential, juicy, and Turkish ingredients to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the menemen mixture onto a tortilla and serving immediately.
